content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "paragraph", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "that Bhartṛihari had 300 wives, and was addicted to a voluptu-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 2, "text": "ous life. But having been severely reproved by his father for", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "his dissolute conduct, he repudiated his wives and collected—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "not composed—these S'atakas by making selections from older", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "writers.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "paragraph", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "", "end": "join"}, {"n": 2, "text": "Since writing the above, I have received an account of a MS.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "of Bhartṛihari at Kolâpore from my friend Mr. Y. V. Athalye,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "containing an extract of the story of Bhartṛihari as related in", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "the commentary in that MS. The story is related at such", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "length that I cannot reproduce it here. It contains no substan-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 7, "text": "tial addition to what we have given in the note to the second", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "Stanza of the Nîtis'ataka, except that it gives the name of Bhar-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 9, "text": "tṛihari's wife as Anangasenâ. I quote the close of this passage of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "the commentary : तदा सप्रत्ययो राजा परं विषादमापन्न इदमुवाच । अहो स्त्रीणां", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "", "end": "join"}, {"n": 12, "text": "चित्तचरित्रं च न केनापि ज्ञायते । धिगेनामेतत्परतन्त्रं मां चेति ॥ न वैराग्यात्परं भाग्यं", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "न बोधादपरः सखा ॥ न हरेरपरस्त्राता न संसारात्परो रिपुः ॥ इत्यादि पठित्वा विक्रमार्कं", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "राज्येभिषिच्य स्वयमत्यन्तं विरक्तः सन्नेतच्छ्लोकत्रयं ( शतत्रयं ? ) च करोति ॥", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "xxii", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "introduction", "number": null, "label": "Introduction", "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["u2", "u3"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "paragraph", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "paragraph", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
